purpose: Produced hull renders for the interface (design/frontend/ONE_PHOTOGRAPH.md section 9, asset 1): new-game and load stage posters, shipworks elevation.
license: Rendered from project-original SpaceFace ship GLBs; no third-party payload.
renderer: Blender Cycles (CPU), the Look restated for Cycles (clear coat, warm key / cyan rim, lamp gain, game reflection env), AgX High Contrast, exposure 0.8, transparent film, 64 samples + denoise, saturation x1.2
lighting: warm key upper-left front, cold rim behind right, low fill, top soft; the world background at 0.35
hidden: COLLISION_HULL and any helper/proxy/collision mesh (the game never draws them)

views.hero: perspective 70 mm, camera on the nose side swung 35 deg to port, 24 deg above, framed to the bounding sphere; 2400 x 1350
views.side: orthographic starboard elevation, nose to the right, ortho scale 1.18 x the longest plan dimension; 2400 x 1100
views.top: orthographic plan, camera straight down, ortho scale 1.18 x the longest plan dimension, rendered nose along +X and published rotated 90 deg counter-clockwise (nose up); marks are in the published image; 1024 x 1024
